inputs.original_text: The Blue Waters owner says the Government takes taxes “without doing or investing in anything.” Now plastic bottles blocking rivers and drains are being used to float the idea of an environmental tax. Convenient: turn a failure to manage the problem into another excuse to collect money, while leaving the question of where existing taxes go unanswered. Don’t mistake a new charge for real investment or accountability.
inputs.modified_text: They’re turning plastic bottles in rivers and drains into a convenient excuse for another tax. The real question is still where the money already collected has gone—and why the problem was allowed to worsen. This looks less like a plan to fix anything than a way to keep collecting while avoiding accountability. Don’t trust a new charge dressed up as environmental concern.
